name: Baimtec Material Co.,Ltd.
summary: Baimtec Material Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of aerospace components and materials. It offers rubber and sealing materials, such as elastic elements, vibration dampers, rubber composite profiles and other rubber components, aerospace rubber sealants, rubber compounds, and other products; high-temperature alloy smelting and casting, including powdered, equiaxed, single crystal, directed, and deformed high temperature alloy products, as well as large castings products; aircraft cockpit transparent parts; and titanium alloy precision casting. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Beijing, China. Baimtec Material Co.,Ltd. is a subsidiary of AVIC …
